steps.text: NA-0779 (D-0048) STOP 004: Settings > Diagnostics. The runner ARMS the log (on + detailed, through debug_log_control) the first time scr-main is visible and EXPORTS it into the run dir at every teardown (the L4 capture); this scenario then drives the pane: the switch and the bar, the live list, Pause/Resume (18d I4: the counts keep growing while Paused, the list stops FOLLOWING -- flight step 13), the filter, the Copy MEASUREMENT (RULING_NA0779_002 R2 (b)), the Export button, and the switch's persistence across a relaunch. 18d (RBANK_second_flight_18d_blessed_20260905): the bar is on the MAIN WINDOW only (I1), reads 'Debug Log: <level>' (I7), the export line is short and transient (I5).
the runner armed the log on scr-main; the STATUS BAR's right end must read 'Debug Log: detailed' on scr-main (18d I7; 18c L5: the pill is gone; the bar speaks)

steps.script: var f=document.querySelector('#scr-settings footer.status-line'); return f ? f.querySelector('.status-left').textContent.indexOf('Relay: not configured')===0 && f.querySelector('.status-right').textContent : 'no bar';

steps.text: 18c L1, RENDERED AT THE MOCKUP's TWO FRAMES: the window is resized to 1120x760 (wide) and 840x600 (narrow); the events list must be the ONLY element that changes height (the card, the toolbar row and the export row keep theirs); a screenshot of each frame is frozen in the run dir for the comparison against the mockup

steps.script: var l=document.getElementById('dl-log').getBoundingClientRect(); var c=document.querySelector('.dl-card').getBoundingClientRect(); var w=window.__qsld_wide||{}; return l.height < w.log - 100 && Math.round(c.height)===w.card && Math.round(document.querySelector('.dl-listhead').getBoundingClientRect().height)===w.row && Math.round(document.querySelector('.dl-exportrow').getBoundingClientRect().height)===w.exp;
var l=document.getElementById('dl-log').getBoundingClientRect(); var w=window.__qsld_wide; return JSON.stringify({wide:w, narrow_log:Math.round(l.height)});

var h=[]; document.querySelectorAll('#pane-diagnostics .dl-ctl, #pane-diagnostics .dl-seg').forEach(function(e){h.push(Math.round(e.getBoundingClientRect().height));}); return h.length>=7 && h.every(function(x){return x===h[0];});

steps.text: the live list: the log's own gw.log on / level_detailed events, a gateway command the pane itself calls (protection_status; settings_get is SYNC and never crosses the gateway, so it has no gw.command by design) and the ui.surface transition are the SAME lines the export carries

steps.script: var t=document.getElementById('dl-log').textContent; return t.indexOf('na0779-fv-passphrase')<0 && t.indexOf('FV')<0 && t.split('\n').every(function(l){return l===''||/^[\x20-\x7e]+$/.test(l);});

steps.text: THE COPY MEASUREMENT (R2 (b)): the button places the export's bytes on the clipboard via navigator.clipboard.writeText; the handler records its result in window.__qsld_dl_copy, and the clipboard is read back with readText where the webview allows it
the row above RECORDS the read-back (the first 40 bytes of the clipboard, or the webview's refusal); the writeText result is the R2 (b) answer, the read-back its corroboration
Pause / Resume and the display filter: the filter narrows what is SHOWN only

18d I4 -- THE MISS AGAINST FLIGHT STEP 13, now asserted: while Paused the ring keeps recording and the counts line keeps growing; only the list stops FOLLOWING. Two gateway calls are provoked (protection_status, a gw.command each at the detailed level); the counts must rise and the shown lines must not.

steps.script: var p=window.__qsld_pause; var n=parseInt(document.getElementById('dl-counts').textContent,10); var s=document.getElementById('dl-log').textContent.split('\n').filter(function(l){return l.indexOf('seq=')===0;}).length; return n>p.counts && s===p.shown;

var t=document.getElementById('dl-log').textContent; var n=parseInt(document.getElementById('dl-counts').textContent,10); var s=t.split('\n').filter(function(l){return l.indexOf('seq=')===0;}).length; window.__qsld_pause.counts2=n; window.__qsld_pause.shown2=s; return s<n;

steps.text: THE EXPORT BUTTON: the directory the operator chose (the run dir here, never the real HOME -- the isolation bracket), one file, its digest verified by the runner's own capture at teardown as well
18d I5: the line is TRANSIENT -- it clears within ten seconds (one one-shot timer) or when the pane is left; polled past the ten seconds here

launch #2 on the persisted profile: the switch PERSISTS (RULING 002 R3) -- the UNLOCK window carries NO bar (18d I1: the bar is the main window's, the unlock window's two texts overlapped at its width); the bar reads 'Debug Log: detailed' on scr-main right after unlock; the contents did NOT persist -- the new session's record begins with gw.unlock

steps.script: return document.querySelector('#scr-unlock footer.status-line')===null && document.querySelectorAll('#scr-unlock .status-bar').length===0 && document.querySelectorAll('#scr-main footer.status-line, #scr-settings footer.status-line').length===2;

var t=document.getElementById('dl-log').textContent; var first=t.split('\n').filter(function(l){return l.indexOf('seq=')===0;})[0]||''; return first.indexOf('seq=1 ')===0 && first.indexOf('ev=gw.unlock')>=0;

steps.text: the runner re-arms the log on THIS launch too (gw.log on / level_detailed appear again by the harness's design); what proves the contents did not persist is the first line above (seq=1 gw.unlock) and the ABSENCE of the previous session's export events
